records.title: security(init): make ripr init --force unlink before create_new
records.release_claim: forced configuration initialization cannot follow a pre-planted symlink or reopen a swapped path after create_new
records.reason: The forced path retained the same symlink/TOCTOU overwrite class already fixed for ordinary init. Unlink plus writing through the returned handle closes both windows.
records.non_claim: The command still overwrites only after explicit --force and does not validate arbitrary existing configuration semantics.

records.title: fix(analysis): route doctor framework detection through adapter signals
records.release_claim: doctor and language adapters share one bounded test-framework detection authority
records.reason: Duplicated detection missed supported AVA, Mocha, unittest, configuration, and Bun forms and could advise against a route the analyzer actually understands. Token-boundary and comment controls keep the shared detector fail-closed.
records.non_claim: Detected framework markers do not prove that tests execute or that every framework feature is supported.

records.title: ux(cli): group the help overview under task headers
records.release_claim: the large command surface is discoverable by setup, analysis, editor/agent, review, policy, and report task
records.reason: Useful first-contact copy, but independently deferrable if no command disappears and the selected release keeps accurate focused help and quick-start documentation.
records.non_claim: Help grouping does not alter command grammar, defaults, costs, or authority.

records.title: fix(doctor): recommend the config-driven Perl route, not an unsupported languages flag
records.release_claim: doctor recommendations for Perl use commands and configuration forms the CLI actually accepts
records.reason: The prior next command named a nonexistent --languages flag and could overwrite an existing enabled-language list. The corrected route is config-driven and preserves existing entries.
records.non_claim: Perl remains feature-gated preview/advisory and is not enabled automatically.

records.title: fix(analysis): disclose Perl preview files
records.release_claim: enabled and available Perl preview files receive explicit advisory language-run and human/JSON disclosure without being counted as Rust or becoming policy authority
records.reason: The adapter could see Perl files while summary/output omitted them or fabricated availability. The fixture and unavailable-feature controls preserve the preview boundary.
records.non_claim: Disclosure does not make Perl a default adapter, gate input, repair-packet authority, or stable tier.

records.title: harden(analysis): name working-tree probe errors instead of swallowing them
records.release_claim: a failed Git working-tree probe cannot silently masquerade as a clean tree
records.reason: The previous false return erased the uncommitted-change disclosure on Git errors. The internal Clean/Dirty/Error state now names failure while refusing to fabricate dirty evidence.
records.non_claim: An error disclosure does not determine whether the tree was actually clean or dirty.

records.title: feat(lib): re-export every public field type from the crate root
records.release_claim: library consumers can name every type exposed through documented CheckInput and CheckOutput fields using public crate-root paths
records.reason: The public integration surface was half-usable when field types were reachable only through hidden modules. The selected additive output types, including per-language counts, require the closure.
records.non_claim: Configured internals and sealed with-config entrypoints remain non-public unless separately accepted.
